metadata.title: Secure Email Platform SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan asserting institutional trust, governance, and responsibility for the Secure Email platform.

import-profile.remarks: Imports the institutional security and privacy control baseline. Secure Email satisfies applicable controls through inherited platform capabilities.

system-characteristics.system-description: The Secure Email Platform provides institutionally governed, authenticated, monitored, and auditable email services supporting human communication, application messaging, workflow coordination, bulk messaging, and records retention.

props.name: platform-capability
props.remarks: Secure Email is treated as a foundational platform service required for institutional operations.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Primary normative guidance for trustworthy email including authentication, policy enforcement, monitoring, and accountability.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for foundational secure email system administration, message handling, and auditability principles.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced to frame email as a mission-critical enabling service with resiliency concerns including misuse, abuse at scale, recovery, and continuity.

system-implementation.remarks: Secure Email is implemented by composition of vetted platform patterns. This SSPP introduces no standalone or compensating controls.

components.title: Secure Email (Composite Trust Assertion)
components.description: Composite assertion that all required trust properties for institutional email are satisfied.

roles.title: Email Platform Governance Authority
roles.remarks: Defines institutional policy, risk tolerance, and trust requirements for email communications.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Executive Cyber Leadership per NIST NICE Framework (SP 800-181).

roles.title: Email Platform Security Architect
roles.remarks: Designs secure email architecture, identity models, delegation semantics, and resiliency dependencies.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Security Architect per NIST NICE Framework.

roles.title: Email Platform Operations
roles.remarks: Operates email infrastructure, gateways, integrations, and policy enforcement mechanisms.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Systems Administrator per NIST NICE Framework.

roles.title: Email Security Monitoring and Response
roles.remarks: Monitors email telemetry, investigates incidents, and coordinates response to phishing, malware, and abuse.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Security Operations Analyst per NIST NICE Framework.

roles.title: Email Records and Legal Compliance
roles.remarks: Manages retention, legal hold, eDiscovery, and evidentiary integrity for email communications.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Legal and compliance role aligned to NIST NICE Framework.

control-implementation.remarks: All applicable security and privacy controls are satisfied through inherited implementations provided by the Secure Email platform patterns. No controls are implemented directly by this SSPP.
